integrity: Exact finite formula derived analytically from a capped-tooth resolvent and resetting renewal equation; limit derived from hyperbolic-function expansions. The 21 numerical checks are auxiliary, not substitute proofs. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to a single unbiased continuous-time searcher on the one-sided finite-height reflecting comb, global Poisson reset, and a single backbone target. The scaling is pointwise at fixed positive kappa,u, with two separately stated iterated endpoint limits. Intermediate optimal-reset uniqueness and finite-optimum convergence are not claimed. Historical priority is provisional, and some later literature was only partially accessible.
title: Exact finite-tooth comb search-time crossover under stochastic resetting
